why: This was our Checkpoint B failure; verifies the server now correctly accepts the {row,col} object format specified in the spec instead of rejecting it as invalid.

name: Firing out of turn returns 403
why: Turn enforcement is a core identity requirement; a broken implementation might allow any player to fire at any time, completely undermining game integrity.

name: Firing into an already-finished game returns 410
why: State sequencing: a server that doesn't track game completion could allow shots after the game ends, corrupting stats with extra shots that never should have happened.
